phrases.english: Plant seeds of hope, watch them grow.
phrases.chinese: 播下希望的种子，静待花开。

phrases.english: Even a small light, shines in the dark.
phrases.chinese: 再小的光，也能照亮黑暗。

phrases.english: Every new day, brings a fresh start.
Believe in yourself, you are stronger.
phrases.chinese: 相信自己，你比想象中强大。

phrases.english: Good things take time, be patient.
